# OpenCoast

> A community-built map of beach and coastal access areas, routes, conditions and evidence.

OpenCoast has one purpose: make local coastal access information and its supporting evidence visible. No account is needed to browse, submit information or suggest a correction. Every published change is reviewed by moderators.

## Public pages

- [OpenCoast | Beach access, coastal rights and routes to shore](https://opencoast.kaelux.dev/): Explore coastal access areas, routes and evidence on OpenCoast. Contribute beach access information anonymously, without an account. Every published change is reviewed.
- [About OpenCoast | A map for public coastal access](https://opencoast.kaelux.dev/about): Why OpenCoast exists: make beach access rights, conditions, routes and evidence easier to understand. Open-source software, anonymous contributions and moderator review.
- [How OpenCoast works | Browse and contribute beach access information](https://opencoast.kaelux.dev/how-it-works): Learn how to read OpenCoast records, draw coastal areas and access routes, add sources anonymously, and follow moderator review with a private receipt.
- [OpenCoast evidence and access labels | Understand a coastal access claim](https://opencoast.kaelux.dev/evidence): Understand allowed, conditional, restricted, disputed and unknown coastal access, document-backed evidence, community review, approximate boundaries and edit dates.
- [Source code](https://github.com/Ker102/opencoast): MIT-licensed software, contribution instructions and project limitations.

## How to interpret records

Access status and evidence strength are separate. Statuses are allowed, conditional, restricted, disputed and unknown. Document-backed records have an official linked source checked by a moderator. Community-reviewed records without a verified official source have a separate label. Unmarked areas have no reviewed information, not an implied right or prohibition. Boundaries may be approximate. Access to an area and access along a route must be checked separately. Last edits and source review dates are distinct.

## Coverage and ownership

Worldwide navigation is available; local coverage depends on approved submissions and is incomplete. Rules vary by jurisdiction. OpenCoast is not an official legal authority. The software is open source; the operator-managed database has no public open-data license asserted. Basemap: OpenFreeMap with OpenStreetMap attribution. Created by Kristofer Jussmann.
